verses.original: Καὶ εὐθὺς πρωῒ συμβούλιον ποιήσαντες οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς μετὰ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων καὶ γραμματέων καὶ ὅλον τὸ συνέδριον δήσαντες τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἀπήνεγκαν καὶ παρέδωκαν Πιλάτῳ
verses.transliteration: Kai euthys prōi symboulion poiēsantes hoi archiereis meta tōn presbyterōn kai grammateōn kai holon to synedrion dēsantes ton Iēsoun apēnenkan kai paredōkan Pilatō
verses.literal: Early in the morning the chief priests - elders scribes and the whole Sanhedrin devised a plan They bound Jesus led Him away and handed Him over to Pilate
verses.literalPt: Logo pela manhã, entraram em conselho os principais sacerdotes com os anciãos, escribas e todo o Sinédrio e, maniatando a Jesus, levaram-no, e entregaram-no a Pilatos.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐπηρώτησεν αὐτὸν ὁ Πιλᾶτος Σὺ εἶ ὁ Βασιλεὺς τῶν Ἰουδαίων Ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς αὐτῷ λέγει Σὺ λέγεις
verses.transliteration: Kai epērōtēsen auton ho Pilatos Sy ei ho Basileus tōn Ioudaiōn Ho de apokritheis autō legei Sy legeis
verses.literal: So Pilate questioned Him Are You the King of the Jews You have said so - Jesus replied . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Pilatos perguntou-lhe: És tu o rei dos judeus? Respondeu Jesus: Tu o dizes.

verses.original: Καὶ κατηγόρουν αὐτοῦ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς πολλά
verses.transliteration: Kai katēgoroun autou hoi archiereis polla
verses.literal: And the chief priests began to accuse Him of many things
verses.literalPt: Os principais sacerdotes fizeram-lhe muitas acusações.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Πιλᾶτος πάλιν ἐπηρώτα αὐτὸν λέγων Οὐκ ἀποκρίνῃ οὐδέν ἴδε πόσα σου κατηγοροῦσιν
verses.transliteration: Ho de Pilatos palin epērōta auton legōn Ouk apokrinē ouden ide posa sou katēgorousin
verses.literal: Then Pilate questioned Him again . . . Have You no answer . . . Look how many charges they are bringing against You
verses.literalPt: Pilatos tornou a perguntar-lhe: Nada respondes? Vê quantas acusações te fazem.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς οὐκέτι οὐδὲν ἀπεκρίθη ὥστε θαυμάζειν τὸν Πιλᾶτον
verses.transliteration: Ho de Iēsous ouketi ouden apekrithē hōste thaumazein ton Pilaton
verses.literal: But to Pilate’s amazement Jesus made no further reply . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Mas Jesus nada mais respondeu, de modo que Pilatos se admirava.

verses.original: Κατὰ δὲ ἑορτὴν ἀπέλυεν αὐτοῖς ἕνα δέσμιον ὃν παρῃτοῦντο
verses.transliteration: Kata de heortēn apelyen autois hena desmion hon parētounto
verses.literal: Now it was Pilate’s custom at the feast to release to the people a prisoner of their choosing
verses.literalPt: Por ocasião da festa, o governador soltava um preso, a pedido do povo.

verses.original: ἦν δὲ ὁ λεγόμενος Βαραββᾶς μετὰ τῶν στασιαστῶν δεδεμένος οἵτινες ἐν τῇ στάσει φόνον πεποιήκεισαν
verses.transliteration: ēn de ho legomenos Barabbas meta tōn stasiastōn dedemenos hoitines en tē stasei phonon pepoiēkeisan
verses.literal: And a man named Barabbas was imprisoned with the rebels who had committed murder during the insurrection
verses.literalPt: Havia um chamado Barrabás, preso com outros sediciosos, os quais, em um motim, haviam feito uma morte.

verses.original: καὶ ἀναβὰς ὁ ὄχλος ἤρξατο αἰτεῖσθαι καθὼς ἐποίει αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: kai anabas ho ochlos ērxato aiteisthai kathōs epoiei autois
verses.literal: So the crowd went up and began asking Pilate to keep his custom . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Chegando o povo, começou a pedir a graça que lhe costumava fazer.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Πιλᾶτος ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς λέγων Θέλετε ἀπολύσω ὑμῖν τὸν Βασιλέα τῶν Ἰουδαίων
verses.transliteration: Ho de Pilatos apekrithē autois legōn Thelete apolysō hymin ton Basilea tōn Ioudaiōn
verses.literal: Do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews - Pilate asked . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe Pilatos: Quereis que eu vos solte o rei dos judeus?

verses.original: ἐγίνωσκεν γὰρ ὅτι διὰ φθόνον παραδεδώκεισαν αὐτὸν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς
verses.transliteration: eginōsken gar hoti dia phthonon paradedōkeisan auton hoi archiereis
verses.literal: For he knew it was out of envy that the chief priests had handed Jesus over . . .
verses.literalPt: Pois ele percebia que, por inveja, os principais sacerdotes o haviam entregado.

verses.original: Οἱ δὲ ἀρχιερεῖς ἀνέσεισαν τὸν ὄχλον ἵνα μᾶλλον τὸν Βαραββᾶν ἀπολύσῃ αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: Hoi de archiereis aneseisan ton ochlon hina mallon ton Barabban apolysē autois
verses.literal: But the chief priests stirred up the crowd to have him release Barabbas to them instead
verses.literalPt: Mas estes instigaram a multidão, para que Pilatos lhes soltasse antes a Barrabás.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Πιλᾶτος πάλιν ἀποκριθεὶς ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς Τί οὖν θέλετε ποιήσω ὃν λέγετε τὸν Βασιλέα τῶν Ἰουδαίων
verses.transliteration: Ho de Pilatos palin apokritheis elegen autois Ti oun thelete poiēsō hon legete ton Basilea tōn Ioudaiōn
verses.literal: So Pilate asked . . . them again What then do you want me to do with the One you call the King of the Jews
verses.literalPt: Pilatos tornou a dizer-lhes: Que farei, então, daquele a quem chamais o rei dos judeus?

verses.original: Οἱ δὲ πάλιν ἔκραξαν Σταύρωσον αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Hoi de palin ekraxan Staurōson auton
verses.literal: And they shouted back Crucify Him
verses.literalPt: Eles clamaram de novo: Crucifica-o!

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Πιλᾶτος ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς Τί γὰρ ἐποίησεν κακόν Οἱ δὲ περισσῶς ἔκραξαν Σταύρωσον αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Ho de Pilatos elegen autois Ti gar epoiēsen kakon Hoi de perissōs ekraxan Staurōson auton
verses.literal: Why asked Pilate What evil has He done But they shouted all the louder Crucify Him
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhes Pilatos: Pois que mal fez ele? Mas clamaram cada vez mais: Crucifica-o!

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Πιλᾶτος βουλόμενος τῷ ὄχλῳ τὸ ἱκανὸν ποιῆσαι ἀπέλυσεν αὐτοῖς τὸν Βαραββᾶν καὶ παρέδωκεν τὸν Ἰησοῦν φραγελλώσας ἵνα σταυρωθῇ
verses.transliteration: Ho de Pilatos boulomenos tō ochlō to hikanon poiēsai apelysen autois ton Barabban kai paredōken ton Iēsoun phragellōsas hina staurōthē
verses.literal: And wishing to satisfy the crowd Pilate released Barabbas to them But he had Jesus flogged and handed Him over to be crucified
verses.literalPt: Pilatos, querendo contentar a multidão, soltou-lhe a Barrabás e, depois de mandar açoitar a Jesus, entregou-o para ser crucificado.

verses.original: Οἱ δὲ στρατιῶται ἀπήγαγον αὐτὸν ἔσω τῆς αὐλῆς ὅ ἐστιν Πραιτώριον καὶ συνκαλοῦσιν ὅλην τὴν σπεῖραν
verses.transliteration: Hoi de stratiōtai apēgagon auton esō tēs aulēs ho estin Praitōrion kai synkalousin holēn tēn speiran
verses.literal: Then the soldiers led Jesus away . . . into the palace (that is the Praetorium and called the whole company together
verses.literalPt: Os soldados levaram-no ao pátio, que é o Pretório, e reuniram toda a coorte.

verses.original: καὶ ἐνδιδύσκουσιν αὐτὸν πορφύραν καὶ περιτιθέασιν αὐτῷ πλέξαντες ἀκάνθινον στέφανον
verses.transliteration: kai endidyskousin auton porphyran kai perititheasin autō plexantes akanthinon stephanon
verses.literal: They dressed Him in a purple robe twisted together a crown of thorns and set it on His head
verses.literalPt: Vestiram-no de púrpura, e puseram-lhe na cabeça uma coroa de espinhos, que haviam tecido,

verses.original: καὶ ἤρξαντο ἀσπάζεσθαι αὐτόν Χαῖρε Βασιλεῦ τῶν Ἰουδαίων
verses.transliteration: kai ērxanto aspazesthai auton Chaire Basileu tōn Ioudaiōn
verses.literal: And they began to salute Him Hail King of the Jews
verses.literalPt: e começaram a saudá-lo: Salve, rei dos judeus!

verses.original: Καὶ ἔτυπτον αὐτοῦ τὴν κεφαλὴν καλάμῳ καὶ ἐνέπτυον αὐτῷ καὶ τιθέντες τὰ γόνατα προσεκύνουν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Kai etypton autou tēn kephalēn kalamō kai eneptyon autō kai tithentes ta gonata prosekynoun autō
verses.literal: They kept striking His head with a staff and spitting on Him And they knelt down . . . . . . and bowed before Him
verses.literalPt: Davam-lhe com uma cana na cabeça, cuspiam nele e, ajoelhando-se, prestaram-lhe homenagem.

verses.original: καὶ ὅτε ἐνέπαιξαν αὐτῷ ἐξέδυσαν αὐτὸν τὴν πορφύραν καὶ ἐνέδυσαν αὐτὸν τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ ἴδια Καὶ ἐξάγουσιν αὐτὸν ἵνα σταυρώσωσιν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: kai hote enepaixan autō exedysan auton tēn porphyran kai enedysan auton ta himatia autou idia Kai exagousin auton hina staurōsōsin auton
verses.literal: After . . . they had mocked Him they removed the purple robe and put His own clothes back on Him Then they led Him out . . . to crucify Him
verses.literalPt: Depois de o terem escarnecido, despiram-lhe a púrpura e puseram-lhe as vestes. Então, o levaram para fora, a fim de o crucificar.

verses.original: Καὶ ἀγγαρεύουσιν παράγοντά τινα Σίμωνα Κυρηναῖον ἐρχόμενον ἀπ’ ἀγροῦ τὸν πατέρα Ἀλεξάνδρου καὶ Ῥούφου ἵνα ἄρῃ τὸν σταυρὸν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai angareuousin paragonta tina Simōna Kyrēnaion erchomenon ap’ agrou ton patera Alexandrou kai Rhouphou hina arē ton stauron autou
verses.literal: Now Simon of Cyrene the father of Alexander and Rufus was passing by on his way in from the country and the soldiers forced him to carry the cross of Jesus
verses.literalPt: Obrigaram a Simão, cireneu, pai de Alexandre e de Rufo, que passava, vindo do campo, a carregar a cruz de Jesus.

verses.original: Καὶ φέρουσιν αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὸν Γολγοθᾶν τόπον ὅ ἐστιν μεθερμηνευόμενον Κρανίου τόπος
verses.transliteration: Kai pherousin auton epi ton Golgothan topon ho estin methermēneuomenon Kraniou topos
verses.literal: They brought Jesus to a place called Golgotha which means The Place of the Skull
verses.literalPt: Levaram-no para o Gólgota, que quer dizer Lugar da Caveira.

verses.original: καὶ ἐδίδουν αὐτῷ ἐσμυρνισμένον οἶνον ὃς δὲ οὐκ ἔλαβεν
verses.transliteration: kai edidoun autō esmyrnismenon oinon hos de ouk elaben
verses.literal: There they offered Him wine mixed with myrrh but He did not take it
verses.literalPt: Deram-lhe vinho misturado com mirra, mas ele não o tomou.

verses.original: Καὶ σταυροῦσιν αὐτὸν καὶ διαμερίζονται τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ βάλλοντες κλῆρον ἐπ’ αὐτὰ τίς τί ἄρῃ
verses.transliteration: Kai staurousin auton kai diamerizontai ta himatia autou ballontes klēron ep’ auta tis ti arē
verses.literal: And they crucified Him They also divided His garments by casting lots to decide what each of them would take
verses.literalPt: Crucificaram-no e repartiram entre si as vestes dele, deitando sortes sobre elas, para ver o que cada um havia de levar.

verses.original: Ἦν δὲ ὥρα τρίτη καὶ ἐσταύρωσαν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Ēn de hōra tritē kai estaurōsan auton
verses.literal: It was the third hour when they crucified Him
verses.literalPt: Era a hora terceira, quando o crucificaram.

verses.original: καὶ ἦν ἡ ἐπιγραφὴ τῆς αἰτίας αὐτοῦ ἐπιγεγραμμένη Ο ΒΑΣΙΛΕΥΣ ΤΩΝ ΙΟΥΔΑΙΩΝ
verses.transliteration: kai ēn hē epigraphē tēs aitias autou epigegrammenē HO BASILEUS TŌN IOUDAIŌN
verses.literal: And the charge inscribed against Him read THE KING OF THE JEWS
verses.literalPt: O título da sua acusação estava escrito em cima: O REI DOS JUDEUS.

verses.original: Καὶ σὺν αὐτῷ σταυροῦσιν δύο λῃστάς ἕνα ἐκ δεξιῶν καὶ ἕνα ἐξ εὐωνύμων αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai syn autō staurousin dyo lēstas hena ek dexiōn kai hena ex euōnymōn autou
verses.literal: Along with Jesus they crucified two robbers one on His right and one on His left
verses.literalPt: Com ele crucificaram dois salteadores, um à sua direita, e outro à sua esquerda.
[E cumpriu-se a Escritura que diz: E com os malfeitores foi contado.]

verses.original: Καὶ οἱ παραπορευόμενοι ἐβλασφήμουν αὐτὸν κινοῦντες τὰς κεφαλὰς αὐτῶν καὶ λέγοντες Οὐὰ ὁ καταλύων τὸν ναὸν καὶ οἰκοδομῶν ἐν τρισὶν ἡμέραις
verses.transliteration: Kai hoi paraporeuomenoi eblasphēmoun auton kinountes tas kephalas autōn kai legontes Oua ho katalyōn ton naon kai oikodomōn en trisin hēmerais
verses.literal: And those who passed by heaped abuse on Him shaking their heads and saying Aha You who are going to destroy the temple and rebuild it in three days
verses.literalPt: Os que iam passando blasfemavam dele, meneando as cabeças e dizendo: Oh! Tu que destróis o santuário e o reedificas em três dias,

verses.original: σῶσον σεαυτὸν καταβὰς ἀπὸ τοῦ σταυροῦ
verses.transliteration: sōson seauton katabas apo tou staurou
verses.literal: come down from the cross and save Yourself
verses.literalPt: desce da cruz e salva-te a ti mesmo.

verses.original: Ὁμοίως καὶ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς ἐμπαίζοντες πρὸς ἀλλήλους μετὰ τῶν γραμματέων ἔλεγον Ἄλλους ἔσωσεν ἑαυτὸν οὐ δύναται σῶσαι
verses.transliteration: Homoiōs kai hoi archiereis empaizontes pros allēlous meta tōn grammateōn elegon Allous esōsen heauton ou dynatai sōsai
verses.literal: In the same way . . . the chief priests and scribes mocked Him among themselves saying He saved others but He cannot save Himself
verses.literalPt: Do mesmo modo, os principais sacerdotes com os escribas, escarnecendo-o, entre si diziam: Ele salvou aos outros, a si mesmo não se pode salvar;

verses.original: ὁ Χριστὸς ὁ Βασιλεὺς Ἰσραὴλ καταβάτω νῦν ἀπὸ τοῦ σταυροῦ ἵνα ἴδωμεν καὶ πιστεύσωμεν καὶ οἱ συνεσταυρωμένοι σὺν αὐτῷ ὠνείδιζον αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: ho Christos ho Basileus Israēl katabatō nyn apo tou staurou hina idōmen kai pisteusōmen kai hoi synestaurōmenoi syn autō ōneidizon auton
verses.literal: Let the Christ the King of Israel come down now from the cross so that we may see and believe And even those who were crucified with Him berated Him
verses.literalPt: desça agora da cruz o Cristo, o rei de Israel, para que vejamos e creiamos. Também os que foram crucificados com ele dirigiam-lhe impropérios.

verses.original: Καὶ γενομένης ὥρας ἕκτης σκότος ἐγένετο ἐφ’ ὅλην τὴν γῆν ἕως ὥρας ἐνάτης
verses.transliteration: Kai genomenēs hōras hektēs skotos egeneto eph’ holēn tēn gēn heōs hōras enatēs
verses.literal: From the sixth hour until the ninth hour darkness came over all the land
verses.literalPt: Chegada a hora sexta, houve trevas sobre toda a terra até à hora nona.

verses.original: καὶ τῇ ἐνάτῃ ὥρᾳ ἐβόησεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς φωνῇ μεγάλῃ Ἐλωῒ Ἐλωῒ λεμὰ σαβαχθάνι ὅ ἐστιν μεθερμηνευόμενον Ὁ Θεός μου ὁ Θεός μου εἰς τί ἐγκατέλιπές με
verses.transliteration: kai tē enatē hōra eboēsen ho Iēsous phōnē megalē Elōi Elōi lema sabachthani ho estin methermēneuomenon Ho Theos mou ho Theos mou eis ti enkatelipes me
verses.literal: At the ninth hour Jesus cried out in a loud voice Eloi Eloi lema sabachthani which means My God My God why . . . have You forsaken Me
verses.literalPt: À hora nona, bradou Jesus em alta voz: Eloí, Eloí, lamá sabactâni? Que quer dizer: Deus meu, Deus meu, por que me desamparaste?

verses.original: Καί τινες τῶν παρεστηκότων ἀκούσαντες ἔλεγον Ἴδε Ἠλίαν φωνεῖ
verses.transliteration: Kai tines tōn parestēkotōn akousantes elegon Ide Ēlian phōnei
verses.literal: When some of those standing nearby heard this they said Behold He is calling Elijah
verses.literalPt: Alguns que ali estavam, ouvindo isso, disseram: Ele chama por Elias.

verses.original: Δραμὼν δέ τις καὶ γεμίσας σπόγγον ὄξους περιθεὶς καλάμῳ ἐπότιζεν αὐτόν λέγων Ἄφετε ἴδωμεν εἰ ἔρχεται Ἠλίας καθελεῖν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Dramōn de tis kai gemisas spongon oxous peritheis kalamō epotizen auton legōn Aphete idōmen ei erchetai Ēlias kathelein auton
verses.literal: And someone ran and filled a sponge with sour wine He put it on a reed and held it up for Jesus to drink . . . saying Leave Him alone Let us see if Elijah comes to take Him down . . .
verses.literalPt: Um deles, correndo, ensopou uma esponja em vinagre e, pondo-a numa cana, deu-lhe de beber, dizendo: Deixai, vejamos se Elias vem tirá-lo.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς ἀφεὶς φωνὴν μεγάλην ἐξέπνευσεν
verses.transliteration: Ho de Iēsous apheis phōnēn megalēn exepneusen
verses.literal: But Jesus let out a loud cry and breathed His last
verses.literalPt: Jesus, dando um grande brado, expirou.

verses.original: Καὶ τὸ καταπέτασμα τοῦ ναοῦ ἐσχίσθη εἰς δύο ἀπ’ ἄνωθεν ἕως κάτω
verses.transliteration: Kai to katapetasma tou naou eschisthē eis dyo ap’ anōthen heōs katō
verses.literal: And the veil of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom
verses.literalPt: O véu do santuário rasgou-se em duas partes, de alto a baixo.

verses.original: Ἰδὼν δὲ ὁ κεντυρίων ὁ παρεστηκὼς ἐξ ἐναντίας αὐτοῦ ὅτι οὕτως ἐξέπνευσεν εἶπεν Ἀληθῶς οὗτος ὁ ἄνθρωπος Υἱὸς Θεοῦ ἦν
verses.transliteration: Idōn de ho kentyriōn ho parestēkōs ex enantias autou hoti houtōs exepneusen eipen Alēthōs houtos ho anthrōpos Huios Theou ēn
verses.literal: When the centurion standing there in front of Jesus saw how He had breathed His last he said Truly this man was the Son of God
verses.literalPt: O centurião que estava em frente de Jesus, vendo-o assim expirar, disse: Verdadeiramente, este homem era Filho de Deus.

verses.original: Ἦσαν δὲ καὶ γυναῖκες ἀπὸ μακρόθεν θεωροῦσαι ἐν αἷς καὶ Μαρία ἡ Μαγδαληνὴ καὶ Μαρία ἡ Ἰακώβου τοῦ μικροῦ καὶ Ἰωσῆτος μήτηρ καὶ Σαλώμη
verses.transliteration: Ēsan de kai gynaikes apo makrothen theōrousai en hais kai Maria hē Magdalēnē kai Maria hē Iakōbou tou mikrou kai Iōsētos mētēr kai Salōmē
verses.literal: And there were also women watching from a distance Among them were Mary Magdalene Mary the mother of James the younger and of Joses and Salome
verses.literalPt: Estavam ali também algumas mulheres observando de longe; entre elas, Maria Madalena, Maria, mãe de Tiago, o menor, e de José, e Salomé;

verses.original: αἳ ὅτε ἦν ἐν τῇ Γαλιλαίᾳ ἠκολούθουν αὐτῷ καὶ διηκόνουν αὐτῷ καὶ ἄλλαι πολλαὶ αἱ συναναβᾶσαι αὐτῷ εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα
verses.transliteration: hai hote ēn en tē Galilaia ēkolouthoun autō kai diēkonoun autō kai allai pollai hai synanabasai autō eis Hierosolyma
verses.literal: These women had followed Jesus and ministered to Him while He was in Galilee and there were many other women who had come up to Jerusalem with Him
verses.literalPt: as quais, quando Jesus estava na Galileia, o acompanhavam e serviam; e além, destas, muitas outras que tinham subido com ele a Jerusalém.

verses.original: Καὶ ἤδη ὀψίας γενομένης ἐπεὶ ἦν Παρασκευή ὅ ἐστιν προσάββατον
verses.transliteration: Kai ēdē opsias genomenēs epei ēn Paraskeuē ho estin prosabbaton
verses.literal: Now it was already evening Since it was Preparation Day (that is the day before the Sabbath )
verses.literalPt: Sendo já tarde, como era a Parasceve (que é véspera do sábado),

verses.original: ἐλθὼν Ἰωσὴφ ὁ ἀπὸ Ἁριμαθαίας εὐσχήμων βουλευτής ὃς καὶ αὐτὸς ἦν προσδεχόμενος τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ τολμήσας εἰσῆλθεν πρὸς τὸν Πιλᾶτον καὶ ᾐτήσατο τὸ σῶμα τοῦ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: elthōn Iōsēph ho apo Harimathaias euschēmōn bouleutēs hos kai autos ēn prosdechomenos tēn basileian tou Theou tolmēsas eisēlthen pros ton Pilaton kai ētēsato to sōma tou Iēsou
verses.literal: Joseph of Arimathea a prominent Council member who himself . . . was waiting for the kingdom of God boldly went . . . to Pilate to ask for the body of Jesus
verses.literalPt: veio José de Arimateia, ilustre membro do Sinédrio, que também esperava o reino de Deus, e, cobrando ânimo, foi a Pilatos, e pediu o corpo de Jesus.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Πιλᾶτος ἐθαύμασεν εἰ ἤδη τέθνηκεν καὶ προσκαλεσάμενος τὸν κεντυρίωνα ἐπηρώτησεν αὐτὸν εἰ πάλαι ἀπέθανεν
verses.transliteration: Ho de Pilatos ethaumasen ei ēdē tethnēken kai proskalesamenos ton kentyriōna epērōtēsen auton ei palai apethanen
verses.literal: Pilate was surprised to hear that Jesus was already dead so he summoned the centurion to ask if this was so . . .
verses.literalPt: Pilatos admirou-se de que já tivesse morrido. Chamando o centurião, perguntou-lhe se, com efeito, estava morto;

verses.original: καὶ γνοὺς ἀπὸ τοῦ κεντυρίωνος ἐδωρήσατο τὸ πτῶμα τῷ Ἰωσήφ
verses.transliteration: kai gnous apo tou kentyriōnos edōrēsato to ptōma tō Iōsēph
verses.literal: When Pilate had confirmed it with the centurion he granted the body to Joseph
verses.literalPt: e, depois que o soube do centurião, deu o corpo a José.

verses.original: Καὶ ἀγοράσας σινδόνα καθελὼν αὐτὸν ἐνείλησεν τῇ σινδόνι καὶ ἔθηκεν αὐτὸν ἐν μνημείῳ ὃ ἦν λελατομημένον ἐκ πέτρας καὶ προσεκύλισεν λίθον ἐπὶ τὴν θύραν τοῦ μνημείου
verses.transliteration: Kai agorasas sindona kathelōn auton eneilēsen tē sindoni kai ethēken auton en mnēmeiō ho ēn lelatomēmenon ek petras kai prosekylisen lithon epi tēn thyran tou mnēmeiou
verses.literal: So Joseph bought a linen cloth took down the body of Jesus wrapped it in the cloth and placed it in a tomb that had been cut out of the rock Then he rolled a stone against the entrance to the tomb
verses.literalPt: Este, tirando-o da cruz, o envolveu em um pano de linho que havia comprado, e o depositou em um túmulo que tinha sido aberto em rocha, e rolou uma pedra para a entrada do túmulo.

verses.original: ἡ δὲ Μαρία ἡ Μαγδαληνὴ καὶ Μαρία ἡ Ἰωσῆτος ἐθεώρουν ποῦ τέθειται
verses.transliteration: hē de Maria hē Magdalēnē kai Maria hē Iōsētos etheōroun pou tetheitai
verses.literal: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joseph saw where His body was placed
verses.literalPt: Maria Madalena e Maria, mãe de José, observaram onde ele foi posto.
